lessons: Review snag only; all checks passed. Keep the seed path, lift, SeedSafety design and every earlier fix and test. Close only the byte-binding gap between review and lift; do not redesign.

Make the reviewed batch the only lift input: return the reviewed seed map (stem -> blob sha) from the check effect's result instead of calling authored_seeds a second time in _check after the invoice passes.
Record each reviewed seed's blob sha on its requisition_review CheckEntry (e.g. a sha field beside path). A journal replay of the check effect must yield the same reviewed shas.

_lift_seeds must refuse (gate_failed, requisition_review finding with a road) any worktree seed not in the reviewed set or whose current blob sha differs from the reviewed sha. Check this before the first write or commit.
SeedSafety must require a passing requisition_review entry whose recorded sha equals the lifted sha for that path. A path-only match is not approval for the bytes on main.

Add tests for two cases: a seed file edited between Check and lift is refused, with no seed committed; and admission is blocked when an entry's recorded sha differs from the lifted sha. Deliberately invert each assertion once to confirm it can fail.
reason: A distinct, fixable review finding (reviewed bytes not bound to lifted bytes) with a concrete paved road; the design is sound and all checks pass.
